normalIntro.en: The word is built on a Latin adverb of comparison, and its family keeps returning to standing above others: as owner, as teacher, as expert, as full control.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词建立在拉丁语的一个比较副词上，它的同族词反复回到「站在他人之上」：作为主人、老师、能手，直到完全的掌控。

normal.en: Latin magis means more, and magister is the person who is more than the others, so the title began as a comparison.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 magis 意为「更多」，magister 就是「比别人更多」的那个人，所以这个头衔起初是一次比较。

normal.en: Old French maistre kept the meaning and lost some letters on the way to English master.
normal.cn: 古法语 maistre 保留了意思，在进入英语 master 的过程中丢掉了一些字母。

normal.en: Master's degree goes back to the medieval university, where a magister was a teacher licensed to lecture.
normal.cn: 硕士学位可以追到中世纪大学，那时 magister 是获准开讲的教师。

normal.en: Mastery adds -y for the state, masterful adds -ful for the quality, and both keep the sense of standing at the top.
normal.cn: mastery 加 -y 指状态，masterful 加 -ful 指性质，两者都保留着「站在顶端」的意思。

normal.en: Master a skill literally repeats the old teacher image: you learn a thing until you could teach it yourself.
normal.cn: master a skill 字面上重复了旧的教师形象：你学一样东西，直到能够自己去教它。

abstract.en: Authority is pictured as a raised hand: a house, a horse and a servant all wait for the same signal.
abstract.cn: 权威被想象成抬起的一只手：房子、马与仆人都等同一个示意。

abstract.en: A degree, a craft and a command share one word because all three are proofs that the training is finished.
abstract.cn: 学位、手艺与掌控共用一个词，因为三者都是「训练已经完成」的凭证。

abstract.en: The word began as a comparison and ended as a certificate, yet both still ask who stands higher.
abstract.cn: 这个词起于一次比较，落成一纸证书，可两者都仍在问：谁站得更高。

examples.en: The old master of the house knew every corner of the garden.
examples.cn: 这座宅子的老主人熟悉园子的每一个角落。

examples.en: He mastered the old engine by taking it apart twice.
examples.cn: 他把那台旧发动机拆了两遍，就把它摸透了。

examples.en: She took a master's degree in urban planning.
examples.cn: 她取得了城市规划专业的硕士学位。

sensesIntro.cn: 核心是站在他人之上的人；义项由此分成一家之主、合格教师与学位、顶尖匠人，以及达到完全掌控的动词用法。

core.cn: 核心意象：老人一抬手，院子里的人、马和仆人都停下来等他的吩咐。

intro.en: A Latin comparative adverb, its comparative noun, the French form of that noun and four English endings carry the word from a lord's hall to a workshop bench.
intro.cn: 一个拉丁语比较副词、由它构成的比较级名词、这个名词的法语形式，再加四个英语词尾，把这个词从领主的厅堂带到工匠的台前。

latinIntro.en: Latin magis, more, and magister, the man who is more than others, are the reliable source of the family; Old French maistre is the form that English borrowed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 magis（更多）和 magister（比别人更多的那个人）是这个词族可靠的源头；英语借入的是古法语形式 maistre。

definition_zh: 前进；行进；进步；进展；发展；使前进
definition_en: movement forward, especially towards a goal, or the gradual development and improvement of something
core_image: 一行人沿着山路一步步往上走，身后的路越拉越长
scene: 山路上的人已经走了大半程，回头还能看见来时的弯道。 The hikers made slow progress up the ridge before the fog closed in.
sceneCN: 这里取「进展、前进的程度」的意思（第 2 个义项：朝更远或更好的状态发展）；句意为雾合拢之前，徒步者沿着山脊缓慢上行。回头可见的弯道说明他们已经走了很远。

derivatives.zh: 由 progress 加 -ive 构成，义为「渐进的；进步的」
由 progress 加 -ion 构成，义为「进展；序列」
由 progressive 加 -ly 构成，义为「逐渐地」

senses.title: Forward movement towards a place
senses.definition: movement forward, especially of a group of people or a vehicle towards a destination
senses.definitionCN: 向前移动，尤指人群或车辆朝目的地行进
senses.example: The army's progress through the valley was slowed by rain.
senses.exampleCN: 军队穿过山谷的行进被雨拖慢了。
senses.why: Latin progredi is built from pro-, forward, and gradi, to walk, so the first sense is simply walking forward.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 progredi 由 pro-（向前）和 gradi（走）构成，所以最初的意思就是「往前走」。

senses.title: Development towards a better state
senses.definition: the gradual improvement or development of a person, a project or a society
senses.definitionCN: 个人、项目或社会逐渐变好或向前发展
senses.example: She has made real progress in her spoken English.
senses.exampleCN: 她的英语口语有了实实在在的进步。
senses.why: Walking forward easily turns into a metaphor for moving towards a goal, so the word came to mean any step towards something better.
senses.whyCN: 「往前走」很容易被用来比喻「朝目标迈进」，于是这个词就指任何向更好状态靠近的一步。

senses.title: To move forward
senses.definition: to move forward or continue on a course
senses.definitionCN: 向前移动，或沿某条路线继续前行
senses.example: The procession progressed slowly along the narrow street.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍沿着窄街缓慢前行。
senses.why: The verb keeps the literal Latin sense of walking on, and its stress falls on the second syllable, unlike the noun.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了拉丁语「继续走」的本义，重音落在第二个音节上，与名词不同。

senses.title: To improve or develop
senses.definition: to develop or improve, especially over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间里逐渐发展或变好
senses.example: Work on the new school is progressing faster than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 新学校的工程进展比预期更快。
senses.why: Because the noun already meant improvement, the verb took on the same figurative sense and now often describes projects and conditions.
senses.whyCN: 既然名词已经表示「变好」，动词也就承接了这层比喻义，如今多用来描述工程与状况。

intro.en: Progress comes from a Latin verb that joins forward to walk, and the noun keeps the same image of a journey towards something.
intro.cn: progress 出自一个把「向前」和「走」合起来的拉丁动词，名词里仍保留着「朝某处走」的画面。

items.en: The prefix pro- meant forward, and gradi meant to walk or to step, so the two together described stepping onward.
items.cn: 前缀 pro- 表示向前，动词 gradi 表示走、迈步，两者合起来就是「向前迈」。

items.en: Progredi meant to go forward, to advance, and its past participle progressus supplied the noun.
items.cn: progredi 意为前进、推进，其过去分词 progressus 提供了名词形式。

items.en: Progressus named a going forward, both on the ground and in the course of events.
items.cn: progressus 指向前行进，既指脚下的路，也指事情的进程。

items.en: Old French progres kept the noun sense of advance and passed it into English.
items.cn: 古法语 progres 保留「前进」的名词义，并传入英语。

items.en: Modern English uses progress for movement and improvement, and also as a verb; the noun stresses the first syllable and the verb the second.
items.cn: 现代英语用 progress 表示行进与进步，也可作动词；名词重音在第一音节，动词重音在第二音节。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same Latin root of stepping; the near-meaning group gathers words for moving and getting better.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁「迈步」词根上的词；近义组收表示前行与变好的词。

entries.definition: Moving forward step by step, or favouring social reform.
entries.definitionCN: 一步步向前的；主张社会改革的。

entries.definition: A series of steps or stages in a process.
entries.definitionCN: 过程中的一连串步骤或阶段。

entries.definition: To move backwards to an earlier or worse state.
entries.definitionCN: 退回较早或较差的状态。

entries.definition: Happening slowly, in small steps.
entries.definitionCN: 缓慢发生的，一步一步的。

entries.definition: Forward movement, or a step towards a goal.
entries.definitionCN: 向前移动，或朝目标迈出的一步。

entries.definition: The process of growing or becoming more advanced.
entries.definitionCN: 成长或变得更先进的过程。

entries.definition: A change that makes something better.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物变好的改变。

entries.definition: Forward movement, especially against difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 尤指克服困难后的前进。

normalIntro.en: The word is a walk turned into a picture of improvement, and its family keeps the same forward step.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词把「走路」变成「变好」的比喻，同族词都保留着那一步向前的动作。

normal.en: Latin gradi means to walk, so progress is first a matter of feet, not of grades.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 gradi 意为「走」，所以 progress 最初说的是脚步，而不是分数。

normal.en: The prefix pro- points forward, which is why progress always carries a direction.
normal.cn: 前缀 pro- 指向前方，所以 progress 总带着方向感。

normal.en: The noun puts the beat on the first syllable and the verb on the second, as English often does with such pairs.
normal.cn: 名词重音在第一音节，动词重音在第二音节，英语里这类成对的词常常如此。

normal.en: Progressive adds -ive: a person or policy that keeps moving forward.
normal.cn: progressive 加 -ive，指不断向前的人或政策。

normal.en: Progression adds -ion: the series of steps that a forward movement leaves behind.
normal.cn: progression 加 -ion，指前进过程中留下的一连串步骤。

abstract.en: A journey and an improvement share one word because both are measured by where you were and where you are.
abstract.cn: 旅程和进步共用一个词，因为两者都要靠「原来在哪、现在在哪」来衡量。

abstract.en: Progress is invisible in a single moment; it only appears when you look back at the distance covered.
abstract.cn: 进度在单独一刻里看不见，只有回头看走过的距离时才显现。

abstract.en: The same word can be a thing and an action, which is why English can say that progress progresses.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既能是事物也能是动作，所以英语里可以说 progress 自己在前行。

examples.en: She has made real progress in her spoken English.
examples.cn: 她的英语口语有了实实在在的进步。

examples.en: The procession progressed slowly along the narrow street.
examples.cn: 队伍沿着窄街缓慢前行。

examples.en: Negotiations are still in progress.
examples.cn: 谈判仍在进行中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑若格瑞斯」——听着像「扑过去，格外卖力」，往前一扑再使劲，就是进步。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ gradi（走）构成 progredi，过去分词 progressus 意为「向前走」，经古法语 progres 进入英语；名词重音在前，动词重音在后。

sensesIntro.en: The core is walking forward; the senses split into the journey itself, the improvement it stands for, and the two verb uses that follow.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「向前走」；义项分成脚下的行进、由它比喻出的进步，以及随之而来的两种动词用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a group of walkers moving steadily along a ridge, with the ground already covered stretching out behind them.
core.cn: 核心意象：一队人沿着山脊稳步向前，走过的路在身后越拉越长。

branches.en: a column of walkers rounding a bend
branches.cn: 一队行人绕过弯道

branches.en: a learner reading a page that once looked impossible
branches.cn: 学习者读着一页曾经觉得很难读的文字

branches.en: a river of people moving through a narrow street
branches.cn: 人流沿着窄街向前移动

branches.en: a building site gaining a floor each month
branches.cn: 工地每个月多出一层

branches.en: a project that is visibly further along than last year
branches.cn: 比去年明显推进了的项目

intro.en: The word is built from a Latin prefix of forward movement and a Latin verb of walking, with English endings added later.
intro.cn: 这个词由表示向前的拉丁语前缀和表示行走的拉丁语动词构成，英语后缀是后来加上的。

latinIntro.en: Latin gradi, to walk, and its participle progressus sit behind the English noun and verb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 gradi（走）及其分词 progressus 是英语名词与动词的来源。

definition_zh: 停止；阻止；堵塞；车站
definition_en: to cease moving or doing something, to block, or a place where a bus stops
core_image: 一只抬起的手掌挡住前行的脚步
scene: 红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。 The light turned red and the car stopped.
sceneCN: 这里 stop 是「停止」（第 1 个义项）；句意：红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。

derivatives.zh: 停止；阻塞
塞子
秒表

senses.title: Cease moving
senses.definition: to cease moving or doing something
senses.definitionCN: 停止移动或停止做某事
senses.example: The car stopped at the light.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车在红灯前停下。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of halting.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示停止的基本义项。

senses.title: Prevent
senses.definition: to prevent something from happening or continuing
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事发生或继续
senses.example: They stopped the leak in time.
senses.exampleCN: 他们及时止住了漏水。
senses.why: Halting an action becomes preventing it.
senses.whyCN: 让动作停下，引申为阻止。

senses.title: Plug a hole
senses.definition: to block a hole or passage
senses.definitionCN: 堵住孔洞或通道
senses.example: He stopped the bottle with a cork.
senses.exampleCN: 他用软木塞塞住了瓶子。
senses.why: The oldest sense was to plug with tow.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项正是用麻絮塞住。

senses.title: A bus stop
senses.definition: a place where a bus or train picks up people
senses.definitionCN: 公交车或火车上下客的地方
senses.example: We met at the bus stop.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在公交车站见面。
senses.why: The place where motion stops takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 运动停下的地点沿用了这个词。

intro.en: Stop first meant to plug a hole, then to halt.
intro.cn: stop 最初表示塞住孔洞，后来才表示停下。

items.en: Latin stuppa meant tow, coarse fibre.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stuppa 指麻絮、粗纤维。

items.en: Stoppian meant to plug with tow.
items.cn: stoppian 意为用麻絮塞住。

items.en: Stop broadened to mean to halt.
items.cn: stop 的词义扩展为停下。

items.en: Stop also meant to prevent.
items.cn: stop 也表示阻止。

items.en: A stop became a place for buses.
items.cn: stop 成为公交车站的名称。

note.en: Stop is compared with look-alike words and with words for halting.
note.cn: 把 stop 与形近词以及表示停止的词作比较。

entries.definition: a movement of the foot

entries.definition: to bend down

entries.definition: a place to buy things
entries.definitionCN: 商店

entries.definition: to come to an end
entries.definitionCN: 终止

entries.definition: to stop suddenly
entries.definitionCN: 骤然停下

entries.definition: to give up doing
entries.definitionCN: 放弃

normalIntro.en: Stop is a hand raised against motion.
normalIntro.cn: stop 是一只对着运动举起的手。

normal.en: The bus stops here.
normal.cn: 公交车在这里停。

normal.en: Stop talking, please.
normal.cn: 请停止说话。

normal.en: We stopped to rest.
normal.cn: 我们停下来休息。

normal.en: The cork stops the bottle.
normal.cn: 软木塞堵住了瓶子。

normal.en: I will stop by after work.
normal.cn: 下班后我顺路过来。

abstract.en: A stop is a small promise to look before going on.
abstract.cn: 停一下，是继续之前先看一眼的小小承诺。

abstract.en: Some stops are endings and some are breaths.
abstract.cn: 有些停下是终结，有些只是呼吸。

abstract.en: You cannot stop the river, only choose where to stand.
abstract.cn: 你拦不住河水，只能选择站在哪里。

examples.en: The light turned red and the car stopped.
examples.cn: 红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。

examples.en: They stopped the leak in time.
examples.cn: 他们及时止住了漏水。

examples.en: We met at the bus stop.
examples.cn: 我们在公交车站见面。

root: 可追溯至拉丁语 stuppa（麻絮），古英语 stoppian 本义是「用麻絮塞住」；由堵塞孔洞，引申为让运动与行为停下，再引申为阻止与车站。

sensesIntro.en: Stop means to halt, to prevent, to plug, or a place where vehicles halt.
sensesIntro.cn: stop 表示停下、阻止、堵塞，或车辆停靠的车站。

core.en: Motion meeting a wall.
core.cn: 运动撞上了一堵墙。

branches.cn: 汽车在红灯前停下。

branches.cn: 他们及时止住了漏水。

branches.en: He stopped the bottle with a cork.

branches.cn: 车站，正是停车发生的地方。

intro.en: Stop doubles its final letter and builds words for halting.
intro.cn: stop 变化时双写词尾，并构成表示停止的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source stuppa meant tow used for plugging.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 stuppa 指用来堵塞的麻絮。

definition_zh: 公民；市民；城镇居民
definition_en: a person who legally belongs to a country; a person living in a city or town
core_image: 持证件站在城市里的一员
scene: 升旗仪式上，老师说我们都是国家的主人。 Every citizen should follow the traffic rules.
sceneCN: 这里 citizen 是「公民」（第 1 个义项：在法律上属于某国的人）；句意是每个公民都应遵守交通规则。

derivatives.zh: 由 citizen 加后缀 -ship 构成，义为「公民身份；国籍」
同源拉丁词根派生，义为「城市的；公民的」
同一拉丁词根的近亲词，义为「城市」

senses.title: A legal member of a country
senses.definition: a person who has legal rights and duties in a country
senses.definitionCN: 在某一国家享有法定权利并承担义务的人
senses.example: As a citizen, she voted in the election.
senses.exampleCN: 作为一名公民，她在选举中投了票。
senses.why: The core sense names a person bound to a state by law.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项命名了在法律上与国家相系的人。

senses.title: A person living in a city or town
senses.definition: a person who lives in a city or town
senses.definitionCN: 居住在城市或城镇里的人
senses.example: Old citizens remember when the town was small.
senses.exampleCN: 老市民还记得小镇很小的时候。
senses.why: Cities once defined membership, so residents of them earned the name.
senses.whyCN: 城市一度定义了成员身份，城里的居民由此得名。

senses.title: A deserving member of a community
senses.definition: a person who behaves well toward their community
senses.definitionCN: 对所在社区表现良好、尽责的人
senses.example: He was praised as a good citizen for helping at the crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 他因在路口帮忙被夸是好公民。
senses.why: Beyond law, a member who serves others earns extra praise.
senses.whyCN: 超越法律层面，服务他人的成员获得了额外的褒扬。

intro.en: Citizen traces to Latin civitas, the community of a city.
intro.cn: citizen 可追溯到拉丁语 civitas，即城市的共同体。

items.en: Latin civis meant a member of a city, and civitas meant the city community.
items.cn: 拉丁语 civis 指城市成员，civitas 指城市共同体。

items.en: Old French formed citain or citeain from the Latin city word.
items.cn: 古法语据此造出 citain、citeain。

items.en: Middle English borrowed it as citezein around the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 约十四世纪中古英语借入为 citezein。

items.en: Modern English simplified the ending to the modern form citizen.
items.cn: 现代英语把词尾简化为 citizen。

items.en: The meaning widened from city membership to national membership.
items.cn: 词义从城市成员扩大到国家成员。

note.en: The first group gathers the civis family; the second gathers person-type words.
note.cn: 第一组收 civis 词族，第二组收身份类词。

entries.definition: The legal status of being a citizen.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「公民身份」，是 citizen 加 -ship。

entries.definition: A large town.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「城市」，与 citizen 同出拉丁词根。

entries.definition: Relating to ordinary people or city life.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「公民的；文明的」，同源词。

entries.definition: A citizen of a nation.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「国民」，强调国家层面。

entries.definition: A person living in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「居民」，只看居住事实。

entries.definition: A person born in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「本地人」，强调出生地。

normalIntro.en: Remember citizen through its Latin city root.
normalIntro.cn: 通过拉丁语「城市」词根记忆 citizen。

normal.en: civis is Latin for a city member.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 civis 指城市成员。

normal.en: city, civil and civic share this root.
normal.cn: city、civil、civic 共享这一词根。

normal.en: citizenship ends with the state suffix -ship.
normal.cn: citizenship 用后缀 -ship 表示身份。

normal.en: senior citizens politely means old people.
normal.cn: senior citizens 是老年人的礼貌说法。

normal.en: a good citizen serves the community.
normal.cn: 好公民服务社区。

abstract.en: See thousands of small figures standing together as one city.
abstract.cn: 想象无数小人影聚成一座城。

abstract.en: Feel the weight of a passport in your hand.
abstract.cn: 感受手中证件的分量。

abstract.en: Hear the oath spoken clearly at the flag-raising.
abstract.cn: 仿佛听见升旗时清晰的誓词。

examples.en: Every citizen has the right to clean water.
examples.cn: 每个公民都有权享用清洁的水。

examples.en: She became a citizen of China last year.
examples.cn: 她去年成为中国公民。

examples.en: Senior citizens ride the bus for free.
examples.cn: 老年人免费乘坐公交车。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西提增」——西城提升我为市民，从此我就是公民。

root: 拉丁语 civis（城市成员）、civitas（城市共同体）→ 古法语 citain → 中古英语 citezein → 现代英语 citizen；同根词有 city（城市）、civil（公民的）、civic（市政的）。

sensesIntro.en: Citizen moves from legal membership to city residents to praiseworthy members.
sensesIntro.cn: citizen 从法定成员延伸到城市居民，再到值得褒扬的社区成员。

core.cn: 核心意象：被城市或国家计入的一个人

branches.cn: 城市生活及其人群

intro.cn: 拉丁语 civis 词根构建了城市词族。

latinIntro.en: Civis and civitas live on in many English words about city life.
latinIntro.cn: civis 与 civitas 保留在许多关于城市生活的英语词中。
